scope: M1 shared POSIX namespace vertical slice
required_user_semantics: Node A mkdir creates multi-level directories visible to Node B through authoritative Meta namespace
Node A create/write publishes a regular file that Node B can read through the same path
Node A rename removes the old name and makes the new name readable on Node B
rename rejects moving a directory into its descendant and preserves file/directory type boundaries
Node A unlink removes a regular file from Node B directory enumeration
a directory larger than one 256-entry Node page is enumerated completely through stable FUSE cookies
successful namespace mutation is visible on Node B on the first following lookup or readdir without eventual-consistency polling
rmdir returns ENOTEMPTY for a non-empty directory and succeeds after unlink
Meta restart and Node restart do not lose committed namespace entries
